entities.name: ord-581b3730f0b74f05a8ccf8b8b656539d
observations: Exact ORD precedent converts the aryl nitro group to the corresponding aryl primary amine.
Recorded components include Pd, methanol, and ethyl acetate; H2 is not explicitly encoded.
The substrate scaffold, ester, heterocycles, and difluoromethoxy substituent remain unchanged.

entities.name: Pd hydrogenation in MeOH
observations: Likely operational condition is H2 with supported Pd, commonly Pd/C, in methanol or a methanol/ethyl acetate mixture.
Room temperature and atmospheric to mildly elevated hydrogen pressure are chemically plausible but not confirmed by the cited ORD record.
No base is indicated or generally required for this nitro reduction.

entities.name: Nitro-to-aniline reduction
observations: Reactant Ar-[N+](=O)[O-] is converted to product Ar-NH2; N-O bonds are removed and nitrogen gains hydrogens without a new heavy-atom bond to another reagent.
